content.value: A 4 kg slender rod rotates in a vertical plane about a pivot at B. A spring of constant $\mathrm { K } = 2 1 0$ Nim and unstretched length 160 mm is attached to the rod as shown. Knowing that in the position shown, the rod has an angular velocity of 3.5 rad/sec counter clockwise, determine the angular velocity of the rod after it has rotated through (i) $9 0 ^ { \circ }$ (ii) $1 8 0 ^ { \circ }$
